title: Remaining POSH duties limited-scope legal review decision record

reviewPrerequisites.description: Confirm the exact controlled Drive files match the registered SHA-256, byte length and page count.
Update the controlled Drive section-mapping workbook with exact Rules physical-PDF pages after the hash gate passes.
Record the qualified legal reviewer's identity or controlled reviewer reference and scope of instruction.

globalDecisions.question: Are the registered Act, Rules and commencement notification current and sufficient for this limited review scope, subject to any identified amendment, notification or supersession condition?
Should the unregistered 2016 POSH terminology-amendment record identified in the expansion plan be verified and added to the governed source pack, or remain excluded?
Are the 35 proposed privacy-safe facts sufficient and appropriately scoped for deterministic review of the six feature families?
Are the proposed statuses and reason-code families suitable, including more-information-needed and specialist-review outcomes where facts or interpretation are incomplete?
Are the complaint, committee, evidence and annual-report privacy boundaries adequate for assessment capture, deterministic processing and any future explanation-provider payload?
Are the proposed customer-wording limitations sufficient to avoid certification, legal approval, guaranteed compliance or unsupported conclusions?

featureDecisions.reviewQuestion: May Section 19 and Rule 13(a), subject to current-law verification, support a deterministic evidence-based review of policy existence, ownership, coverage, dissemination and review evidence without claiming legal approval?

May Section 19(c) and Rule 13(b)-(f), subject to current-law verification, support deterministic review of awareness, orientation and capacity-building evidence without certifying legal sufficiency from attendance evidence alone?
May Section 19(b) and Rule 13(e), subject to current-law verification, support per-location review of required display evidence without generalising one location's evidence to all offices or units?

May Sections 9-18 and Rules 6-12, subject to exact-file and current-law verification, support a control-only review of complaint routes, timelines, confidentiality and records without collecting or transmitting case content?

May Section 4(1)-(2) and Rule 3, subject to exact-file and current-law verification, support deterministic review of committee composition and office or administrative-unit coverage without inferring unit facts from company totals?
May Sections 21-22 and Rule 14, subject to exact-file and current-law verification, support privacy-safe review of annual-report preparation and submission using aggregate control evidence only?

completionRules: A blank decision is not approval.
An official source is not by itself an approved product interpretation.
No feature may receive RAG approval until the exact controlled Drive file hash and section scope are recorded.
No feature may become live-governed until legal review conditions, facts, deterministic rules, chunks, retrieval, provider, endpoint, UI and regression gates pass.
The repository decision record must agree with the controlled Drive review register before release.
